query:
SELECT rm.id, rm.name, rm.category 
FROM raw_materials rm 
WHERE rm.category LIKE '%huile%' OR rm.category LIKE '%essential%' OR rm.name LIKE '%HE %' OR rm.name LIKE '%Huile%'
ORDER BY rm.name 
LIMIT 30;
